name: notify
doc: A toast. Superset of ox lib.notify, QBCore:Notify, ESX.ShowNotification, okokNotify and mythic_notify. Drawn by `notice` in a stack per position.

id.doc: Re-sending with the same id updates the toast in place and restarts its timer.

title.doc: Plain text. A toast with neither title nor description is dropped.

description.doc: Second line. ox markdown (bold, italic, inline code) is rendered; nothing else.

status.doc: Picks the icon and its colour; the surface stays neutral. The Lua API also accepts ox/qb words: inform, primary, default → info; danger → error.

alignIcon.doc: Where the icon sits when there are two lines. Default: top with two lines, center with one.

showDuration.doc: A line under the toast drains over `duration`.

sound.doc: Never reaches the page: the caller's Lua plays it (ox strips it the same way).

style.doc: Inline CSS (camelCase) merged over the toast. Escape hatch for adapters; themed UIs don't need it.
